item.title: pawfal.org: Dave Griffiths' music software and blog
item.author: emecas
item.description:
pawfal.org: Dave Griffiths’ music software and blog
http://www.pawfal.org/
Dave Griffiths’ site: free music software from the early 2000s (SSM, the SpiralSynth Modular synthesizer, and plugins for it) and his blog on games, livecoding and art. Today the home page only links to Dan’s and Dave’s blogs.

mi

Music Intellegence is a collection of plugins for SSM that use artificial life to create patterns for generating innovative music.

Built with 0.1.0b2 version of SSM.
